assets.name: USDC
assets.label: Stability Layer
assets.description: On-chain dollars for fast settlement and global movement. Useful as digital cash and a bridge between systems. Custodied risk acknowledged and contained.

assets.name: Bitcoin (BTC)
assets.label: Sovereign Base Asset
assets.description: Fixed supply. No issuer. Censorship-resistant. Designed for long-term wealth preservation outside institutions.

assets.name: Ethereum (ETH)
assets.label: Settlement & Computation Layer
assets.description: Programmable money and smart contracts. Foundation for decentralized finance and tokenized systems.

assets.name: Solana (SOL)
assets.label: High-Performance Network
assets.description: Low fees, high throughput, application-first ecosystem. Exposure to consumer-scale adoption.

assets.name: Zcash (ZEC)
assets.label: Privacy Layer
assets.description: Shielded transactions and financial confidentiality. A hedge against total surveillance.

stages.description: Understanding the cycles—why this moment, what's shifting, where the fork points. Arc & Fork provides the map.
